title: mir
description: Machine-readable description of an X Intrinsics (Xt) widget set, primarily Motif.

prefix.description: Toolkit prefix stripped from widget class names to derive widget keys.

widgets.description: Widgets keyed by widget class symbol (e.g. xmPushButtonWidgetClass).

name.description: Widget class name string from core.class_name (e.g. XmPushButton).

include.description: Path to the header file that declares the widget class.

superclass.description: The WidgetClass symbol pointing to the class record referenced by core.superclass (e.g. xmPrimitiveWidgetClass).

methods.description: Global functions whose names start with the widget's core.class_name (case-sensitive) and whose first parameter is Widget, keyed by full function symbol.

name.description: Human-readable method name with the widget's core.class_name prefix stripped (e.g. Highlight for XmCascadeButtonHighlight).

parameters.description: Signature parameters after the leading Widget, keyed by parameter name. Unnamed parameters use arg1, arg2, etc. (with underscores to avoid collisions) and have an empty name.

type.description: C parameter type, preserving typedef names.

return_type.description: C return type from the method signature, preserving typedef names.

resources.description: Dictionary of resources declared in core.resources, keyed by resource name. Entries may be empty placeholders during extraction.

ctype.description: Declared C type of the field referenced by the entry's fifth-field XtOffsetOf(OBJ, FIELD), preserving typedef spelling. Falls back to the fourth-field sizeof(TYPE) when the field cannot be resolved.

rtype.description: Declared resource type string from the entry's third field (XtResource.resource_type, e.g. Pixel).

class.description: Resource class string from the entry's second field (XtResource.resource_class, e.g. Background).

construct.description: Whether the resource can be supplied when constructing the widget.

set.description: Whether the resource can be set after widget construction.

get.description: Whether the resource can be retrieved from the widget.
